description: This file defines the AlarmService interface for managing alarms within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for creating, updating, acknowledging, clearing, assigning, deleting alarms, and querying alarm data.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: Interface for alarm management operations including creation, update, acknowledgment, clearance, assignment, deletion, and querying of alarms.

methods.name: createAlarm
methods.description: Creates a new alarm, with an overload that allows enabling or disabling alarm creation.

methods.name: updateAlarm
methods.description: Updates an existing alarm with provided fields.

methods.name: acknowledgeAlarm
methods.description: Acknowledges an alarm, marking it as acknowledged.

methods.name: clearAlarm
methods.description: Clears an alarm, optionally with details and event push.

methods.name: assignAlarm
methods.description: Assigns an alarm to a user.

methods.name: unassignAlarm
methods.description: Unassigns an alarm from a user.

methods.name: delAlarm
methods.description: Deletes an alarm by ID, with an overload to check and delete alarm type.

methods.name: delAlarmTypes
methods.description: Deletes specified alarm types for a tenant.

methods.name: findAlarmById
methods.description: Retrieves an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: findAlarmByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: findAlarmInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves alarm info by ID.

methods.name: findAlarms
methods.description: Finds alarms based on a query.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarms
methods.description: Finds alarms for a specific customer based on a query.

methods.name: findAlarmsV2
methods.description: Finds alarms using the version 2 query.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarmsV2
methods.description: Finds customer alarms using the version 2 query.

methods.name: findHighestAlarmSeverity
methods.description: Finds the highest severity of alarms for an entity.

methods.name: findLatestActiveByOriginatorAndType
methods.description: Finds the latest active alarm by originator and type.

methods.name: findLatestActiveByOriginatorAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds the latest active alarm by originator and type.

methods.name: findAlarmDataByQueryForEntities
methods.description: Finds alarm data for entities based on a query.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByAssigneeId
methods.description: Finds alarm IDs assigned to a user.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByOriginatorId
methods.description: Finds alarm IDs by originator ID.

methods.name: deleteEntityAlarmRecords
methods.description: Deletes alarm records for an entity.

methods.name: deleteEntityAlarmRecordsByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all alarm records for a tenant.

methods.name: countAlarmsByQuery
methods.description: Counts alarms matching a query.

methods.name: findAlarmTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds alarm types for a tenant.

methods.name: findActiveOriginatorAlarms
methods.description: Finds active originator alarms with filtering.
